hook: A free, open-source TablePlus alternative, written in Rust.

beats.say: Tabletist is a free, MIT-licensed database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite, on macOS, Linux and Windows.
It's written in Rust with egui, with no Electron and no web view. The universal Mac download is just thirty-seven megabytes.
It's careful with production: those connections open read-only, edits wait until you save, you can read the exact SQL first, and a save never overwrites a row someone else changed.
